title: Recommend blue-green logical replication topology when upgrade plan is explicit

why_now: The intake names a blue-green upgrade and zero-downtime PostgreSQL migration, so the topology should be designed explicitly now.
why_not_yet: The plan still needs lag gates, sequence handling, validation queries, write-freeze rules, and rollback ownership.
triggers_for_next_stage: Run rehearsal cutovers and compare pg_stat_statements before and after the upgrade window.
